items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Carmen and I were married while I was in training... I'd know Carmen since the '30s, because she lived across the street from me... Carmen and I, when I found out Carmen was a friend of Billie's, that was it, and with Irene. I was right in the crowd. I was one of the gang

ctx.x: But we all showed. He told me, 'Well, Kenny, come to rehearsal at such and such a date.' He said, You'll get adjusted.' So I went home to see my brother and all that, and Carmen and I were married while I was in training.
I didn't know you were married to Carmen.
